title: Stroller Walk Distance vs Nap Quality
dataSources: Baby feedings (`baby:feed`), baby sleep (`baby:sleep`), diaper changes (`diaper:change`), school departures (`school:departure`), stroller activity (`stroller:walk`), household chores (`chore:event`), and family geofence events (`family:location`).
app: Family and baby telemetry from baby-tracking apps, school and geofence automations, stroller logs, chore trackers, and shared-home events streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and Home Assistant.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stroller:walk
| stats avg(distance_km) as avg_distance_km avg(post_walk_nap_min) as avg_post_walk_nap_min by route
| sort - avg_post_walk_nap_min
description: Compares stroller routes by average distance and the quality of the nap that followed.
value: This view turns trial-and-error into evidence by showing which walks seem to help the baby settle best afterward.
implementation: Ingest stroller route summaries from a phone or watch along with the duration of the following nap.
visualization: Scatter plot of walk distance versus post-walk nap duration by route.
grandmaExplanation: It maps which stroller walks seem to lead to the best naps afterward.
